latest.title: Signs of life in traumatic OHCA
latest.finding: 4.8% survived beyond the ED; 25% where cardiac activity and spontaneous respiration were both present at scene, 8.5% with cardiac activity alone, and none among the 318 patients (68.8%) with no signs of life

latest.title: Prehospital pain assessment happens too rarely
latest.finding: Prehospital pain was assessed and documented in only 22.5–46.7% of patients; pain-management interventions were associated with reduced pain intensity but could not be pooled

latest.title: One in five transports: brief stay, no intervention
latest.finding: 15.1% of patients were non-conveyed; among the 84.9% transported, 19.1% had a ≤6-hour stay with no documented procedure, medication or imaging, and short-term mortality was 0.4% versus 1.3% for stays over six hours
